name: Optin Forge
author: Smarty Soft

sections.description:
Optin Forge is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help you create and manage marketing campaigns to generate leads and improve conversion rates.

Key Features

  • Easy Campaign Creation: Create new campaigns with just a few clicks
  • Customizable Templates: Choose from a variety of pre-designed templates
  • Visual Campaign Builder: Design your campaigns visually without coding
  • Campaign Management: Enable/disable campaigns with a simple toggle
  • Page Integration: Easily integrate your campaigns with any WordPress page
  • Responsive Design: All campaigns look great on any device

Use Cases

  • Lead generation for newsletters
  • Product promotions
  • Content upgrades
  • Special offers and discounts
  • Subscriber growth
  • Event registration

Who Is This Plugin For?

  • Marketers looking to grow their email list
  • Business owners wanting to promote their products
  • Bloggers seeking to increase their subscriber base
  • Anyone looking to improve website conversion rates

Technologies for Optimal Performance

Optin Forge leverages modern web technologies to deliver a smooth, responsive experience:

  • Vue.js: Powers the intuitive admin interface and real-time campaign preview functionality
  • React.js: Handles dynamic components and state management for a seamless user experience
  • Grapes.js: Drives the visual drag-and-drop campaign builder for code-free design customization
  • WordPress REST API: Enables fast, efficient communication between the frontend and backend
  • Modern PHP: Built with clean, efficient PHP code following WordPress best practices
  • Responsive Design: All templates are fully responsive and tested across multiple devices

These technologies work together to ensure Optin Forge delivers high performance while maintaining an intuitive user experience for marketers and website owners of all technical skill levels.

Privacy Policy

Optin Forge collects user-submitted data through campaign forms. This data is stored in your WordPress database. The plugin itself does not share any data with external services unless you configure integrations with third-party services.

Please ensure your site’s privacy policy reflects the data collection performed by your Optin Forge campaigns.

License

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/optin-forge directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Navigate to the Optin Forge menu item in your WordPress admin to start creating campaigns
sections.faq:
How do I create my first campaign?

Navigate to the Optin Forge dashboard in your WordPress admin, click “Create New Campaign,” select a template, provide the necessary details, and save.

Can I customize the templates?

Yes, each template can be fully customized using our visual builder to match your brand’s look and feel.

How do I activate or deactivate a campaign?

In the Optin Forge dashboard, simply toggle the switch on a campaign card between “Published” and “Draft” status.

Can I integrate campaigns with specific pages?

Yes, when creating or editing a campaign, you can select specific WordPress pages where the campaign should appear.

Are the campaigns mobile-friendly?

Yes, all campaigns are designed to be fully responsive and work well on all devices.

  • Implemented template management system

  • Integrated trigger system (Immediate, Delay, Exit Intent)
  • Added page-specific targeting options
  • Included responsive design support
  • Added subscriber tracking and data collection (integration with Mailerlite)

1.0.1

  • Issue resolved related to plugin review

1.0.0

This is the first release of Optin Forge.
